messages:
natasha: Heads-up: we flipped the strict fncall schema gate for route `FnRoute:lookup_v2` in the canary and console is showing a surge of validation rejects (~0.9% of the canary slice). Looks partner-heavy. Need ops playbook.

omar: Any sample payloads?

bryan: Pasting a quick log excerpt — adapters returning arrays instead of the expected object: 
```json
{"fn": "lookup_v2", "resp": [{"id":"abc"}], "meta": {"partner": "old-adapter"}}
```
We expect `resp` to be an object: `{items: [{id: int, name: string}], count: int}` so this fails schema.

samir: Validator owner. We intentionally set reject to catch regressions but didn't account for partner distribution in this slice. Do we have partner-level breakdown on the dashboard?

natasha: Not yet — current tiles are model+route aggregated. Ops asked to avoid firing pagers for now.

omar: Immediate options: (A) revert to permissive for canary; (B) switch to warn-mode (log metric + return 200); (C) add compatibility coercion in runtime to coerce obvious shapes. (B) seems fastest.

bryan: Agree (B). If we keep rejects but still return success callers won't be impacted and we'll keep telemetry. Also request we sample failing payloads to s3 for triage.

samir: I'll push a hotfix: set gate_mode = "warn" for route_id 0x9f3 on the canary. Implementation will: increment `fncall.schema_warns` with tags route/partner/model; return 200 with header `X-Fncall-Validation: warn`; and set `tool_passthrough: true` in proxy.

routebot: deploy-bot: toggle requested by @samir. Canary-only change queued. CI quick checks passed. ETA 8m.

omar: Add a sampling hook: redact PII and capture 0.5% of warn events into `s3://redwood/fncall/samples/compat/` with partner and route tags. That will help triage.

bryan: Long-term: we should consider a runtime compat shim + routing quarantine list. Ops should be able to tag partner IDs as `compat-v1` and runtime will route their traffic to `fn-compat-v1` variant. That avoids changing validator globally.

samir: Agreed. I'll prototype a minimal coercion layer that handles common cases: array->object if single-element array maps to expected field, null->empty-object, string-number coercion for id fields. We'll gate it behind `compat_mode` flag per-route.

omar: Product/UI ask: can we add a dashboard panel that breaks `schema_warns` by `partner` and highlights canary slices? Current per-model graph hides partner concentration.

bryan: Also important: metrics provenance. Add an `ingest_origin: canary_warn` tag so backfills/replays can be filtered and we don't double-count.

samir: Hotfix merged; warn-mode on for route 0x9f3. Sampling hook active. Telemetry showing warns but no 4xxs.

omar: I pulled initial samples — top offenders: old-adapter, legacy-sync, thirdparty-lite. I'll ping account teams for outreach and start a quarantine list.

bryan: I'll start a short design doc for runtime quarantine + compat shim and include a small SDK helper for partners to read model shape expectations and run a local validation check.

natasha: Thanks everyone. Action items: samir: postmortem with metrics and exact query; omar: quarantine list + account tags; bryan: design doc for compat shim + SDK helper; ops: add partner-split dashboard tile. We'll re-evaluate after 24h. :white_check_mark:
